title: MJ-12 document: Cardinal Spellman given access to Roswell materials

tellings.quote: And there's one document around uh Francis Spellman being given access to the Roswell materials.

plain: One of the Majestic 12 papers, documents said to come from a secret group set up to handle crashed saucers, reportedly states that the Catholic cardinal Francis Spellman was given access to the materials from Roswell, the 1947 crash in New Mexico. Michels mentions this document himself, in passing. If genuine, it would mean a senior churchman was let into the most closely held secret of the day.
